title: Censoring, truncation, and measurement-error likelihood boundary with zero-row lock
hypothesis: A deterministic synthetic observation-process contract can distinguish censoring from truncation and can reject likelihood fixtures that omit declared measurement error while preserving a hard zero-real-row boundary.
null_or_failure: Censored values are treated as exact, truncated records remain in the sampling frame, interval bounds reverse, error units disagree, latent and observed values are conflated, missingness is silently informative, or synthetic likelihood structure becomes a GMUT fit or empirical confirmation claim.
test_falsifier_or_gate: Run exact, left-censored, right-censored, interval-censored, truncated, unit-mismatch, omitted-error, informative-missingness, and real-row-promotion fixtures; require malformed observation processes to fail while real rows, fits, likelihood results, and independent reviews remain zero.
rollback_or_recovery: Retain the failed fixture, restore the declared observation and error model, freeze it before future data access, and require a separately preregistered real-data likelihood analysis and independent review for promotion.
boundary: Observation-process fixtures are synthetic with zero real rows, likelihood results, fits, or independent statistical reviews.
